bluf: Al Jazeera, The Guardian and France 24 reported that Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan’s Senate race; The Guardian and France 24 said El-Sayed would become the first Muslim US senator. Reuters reported, citing sources, that drones attacked Iranian Kurdish opposition in Sulaymaniyah and east Erbil in Iraq.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that European law enforcement authorities arrested seven suspects and seized more than 100 servers in a joint action targeting an unnamed company suspected of providing fraudulent trading websites to criminal gangs.

items.text: The Guardian reported that the UK apologised to Ukrainian child refugees who were told to study Russian in English schools and launched funding for a new Ukrainian GCSE.
Reuters reported, citing sources, that drones attacked Iranian Kurdish opposition in Sulaymaniyah and east Erbil in Iraq.
The Guardian reported that a public inquiry called for the AUKUS nuclear submarine agreement to be suspended and for a royal commission.
The Guardian reported that a mother died and her daughter was missing in western Canada after a suspected grizzly bear attack.
Abdul El-Sayed defeated Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race, according to Al Jazeera, The Guardian and France 24; The Guardian and France 24 said he would become the first Muslim US senator.
BBC News World reported that James Talarico became the first Democrat to win a Texas Senate seat since 1988.
